• **Director 2** – Executive Director (appointed 3 Jun 1993) | | **Shareholders** | • Director 1 – 57.42 % (individual)
• Director 2 – 42.58 % (individual) | | **Auditor** | Audit Firm 4 (unqualified opinion for FY 2022‑2024) | ### Recent Financial Highlights (FY ending 31 Mar) | Year | Revenue (RM) | Net Profit (RM) | Net Profit % | Quick Ratio | Leverage (Debt/Equity) | |------|--------------|----------------|--------------|-------------|------------------------| | **2022** | 25.10 M | 1.39 M | 5.55 % | 1.64 | 1.49 | | **2023** | 26.62 M | 2.03 M | 7.61 % | 1.51 | 1.18 | | **2024** | 27.55 M | 1.87 M | 6.77 % | 1.80 | 1.02 | **Key take‑aways** * **Revenue growth:** Steady increase from RM 25.1 M (2022) to RM 27.5 M (2024) – roughly 9 % cumulative growth over three years. * **Profitability:** Gross margins hover around 52‑54 %; operating profit margin improved to 11.3 % in 2023 before settling at 10.2 % in 2024. Net profit margin peaked at 7.6 % in 2023, indicating solid earnings from core operations. * **Liquidity:** Quick ratio consistently above 1.5, showing the firm can meet short‑term obligations without relying on inventory (which is nil). Cash‑to‑revenue ratio is low (≈3‑7 %), but operating cash flow is strong (RM 3.2‑3.8 M) and free cash flow remains positive. * **Capital structure:** Debt levels are being reduced; leverage fell from 1.49× in 2022 to just over 1.0× in 2024. Interest coverage is healthy (≈7‑9×), and debt‑service coverage stays above 3×. * **Operational efficiency:** Days sales outstanding stay around 87‑93 days, while days payables are similar, resulting in a near‑zero cash conversion cycle in 2022‑2023 and a slight positive cycle in 2024. Asset turnover is strong (~1.4‑1.5×), reflecting efficient use of the RM 19.2 M asset base. ### Overall Assessment Delima Pacific Academy is a financially stable, actively growing education‑training provider. The company enjoys strong profitability on a modest scale, maintains ample liquidity, and is steadily deleveraging while expanding revenue. With a focused ownership structure (the two directors own 100 % of equity) and clean audit opinions, the firm appears well‑positioned to continue delivering professional accounting and finance courses in the Kuala Lumpur market.
